note: AutoCAD LT is a distinct commercial target. MyDesk Draft LT provides dedicated 2D drafting, layer styles, and vector exchange with independent binary and packaging.

capabilities.name: Professional 2D drafting core
capabilities.reference_behavior: LT focuses on 2D drafting, annotation, and plotting without 3D solid modeling.
capabilities.expected_output: Drawing persists with layers and dimensions
capabilities.differences: Dedicated MyDeskDraftLT binary. 3D solid modeling omitted by design.

capabilities.name: 3D solid modeling excluded by LT product scope
capabilities.reference_behavior: AutoCAD LT does not include 3D solid modeling. Tracking this as unsupported-for-LT prevents counting it against LT parity.
capabilities.evidence: Automated test confirms 3D solid operations (EXTRUDE, PRESSPULL) are unavailable in Draft LT, matching AutoCAD LT scope.
capabilities.differences: Omitted by design from AutoCAD LT product definition.

capabilities.name: Linetypes and lineweights
capabilities.command: LAYER LTYPE / CHPROP LTYPE / LTSCALE / LAYER LWEIGHT
capabilities.reference_behavior: LT supports layer and entity linetypes and lineweights for drafting and plot.
capabilities.differences: Full parity on standard linetypes and lineweights.

capabilities.name: Named layer states
capabilities.reference_behavior: Named layer snapshots restore drawing visibility and graphical layer properties.
capabilities.expected_input: Save a state, alter layers, restore the state
capabilities.expected_output: Captured properties and current layer are restored as one undoable edit
capabilities.performance: Capture and restore are linear in layer count
capabilities.evidence: Draft LT regression coverage verifies command save/restore, property and active-layer restoration, undo/redo, and native schema-7 persistence.
capabilities.differences: No .las interchange, selective property masks, viewport overrides, or added-layer restore options.

capabilities.name: Layouts and PDF plot
capabilities.reference_behavior: Paper space layouts and PDF plot are core LT deliverables.
capabilities.evidence: Vector SVG/PDF layout plot engine renders sheets, paper setup dimensions, and layout viewports.
capabilities.differences: Vector SVG and PDF plotting implemented; printer driver direct rasterizer in progress.

capabilities.name: DWG interoperability
capabilities.reference_behavior: Open and save DWG drawings used by LT customers.
